summary: This Form 8-K, filed by Structured Obligations Corporation on behalf of Select Notes Trust LT 2004-1, reports a routine periodic distribution to certificate holders for the September 1, 2026 Interest Distribution Date. The filing includes a trustee's report from U.S. Bank National Association detailing interest received and per-certificate amounts. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic action; rather, it is a standard asset-backed securities periodic reporting obligation under the Exchange Act. The registrant notes that underlying issuers are subject to SEC reporting and that the trustee performed no due diligence. No deal terms are present.
